component.name: Earbuds
component.summary: Noise control, equalizer and battery for JBL earbuds

description.p: Earbuds does what the JBL Headphones phone app does, in a small native GNOME window: no phone, no account, no internet.

ul.li: Battery of each earbud and the case
Noise cancelling, Ambient Aware, TalkThru or off
JBL's equalizer presets, or your own ten-band curve
VoiceAware, voice prompts, Safe Sound and automatic power off
Find your earbuds by making one of them beep

description.p: Made for and tested on the JBL Wave Buds 2. Other JBL earbuds that speak the same protocol show the settings they answer for. Earbuds is not affiliated with JBL or Harman.
